title: Move the Step 7 randomization declaration into the robots package
summary: randomization.py moves from src/locomotion/ to src/locomotion/robots/ with unchanged bytes (SHA-256 d5823da0...). The import rules let the native omniwalk environment import only robots, so this placement lets the native Step 7 work use the declaration without a new import edge. The module imports only robots.hexapod and robots.rs05. The table2_v1 (730cad98...) and none (be43cdf0...) declaration hashes are unchanged, and the none oracle still replays bit for bit. The surrogate, its tests and the guides now import locomotion.robots.randomization; the source inventory archives the old path at f7f6a514. robots/__init__.py is unchanged, so native physics source identity is unchanged.
